simple.meaning: יָגוֹן (yâgôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “affliction.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יָגוֹן (H3015) appears 14 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 42:38, with occurrences in Genesis, Esther, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָגוֹן (H3015) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יָגוֹן (H3015) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יָגוֹן (yâgôwn) / H3015 is traced through Genesis 42:38, Genesis 44:31, Esther 9:22, Psalms 13:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
